description: Experience the ultimate in luxury and sophistication aboard the Marquis 70, a stunning motor yacht designed for comfort, style, and unforgettable moments on the water. With its sleek lines, spacious interiors, and top-tier amenities, this yacht offers a premium cruising experience for private gatherings, corporate events, or celebratory occasions.
what_is_included: Captain and crew *not included* in rental price. Captain/crew fees are **$200/hr plus gratuity** for this vessel.
check_in_details: Charters can run from multiple of our locations by request.
